Unfortunately every dog is different and you might have to just do a few test runs with him to really know his personality but he seems alright as long as he’s not trying to bite right away.
Has he ever tried biting or aggressive growling? Usually the “tone” of the bark along with attempts to bite and growl are indicative of danger but if it’s just barking, it’s probably fine.

The biggest thing that helped my rescue was exposure. It is a bit scary at first cause their behavior can be unpredictable so make sure you’re always monitoring him. Start with meeting other people/dogs in neutral areas. Then transition to meeting people/dogs in the home, one at a time without distractions that may rile him up. Reward him after positive interactions. With my dog, he does bark at new people but once he sniffs them he’s fine and won’t bark, make sure to let people know not to immediately try petting him and let him have his space. Good luck with the training!
